summary: Vendored the three variable WOFF2 faces, declared them locally with the existing family names and weight ranges, and replaced the Google Fonts stylesheet/preconnects with base-aware preloads for DM Sans and Manrope.
choices: Used font-display: swap so text remains visible while a local face loads.
Loaded font assets from src/assets so Vite can hash and prefix both CSS URLs and preload URLs for the configured base path; preloaded only the body and heading faces.
openQuestions: No formatter/linter or file-scoped typecheck is configured. The available typecheck script is project-wide; build, test, and visual verification were not run under this turn's restrictions, so emitted base-path URLs and runtime rendering remain unverified.
